sources.claim: NHS Digital reports that most observed Egregor infections used remote access trojan delivery, notably Qbot.
Sophos reports some tracked Egregor attacks were linked with Qbot activity.
MITRE ATT&CK says QakBot evolved into a delivery agent for ransomware, notably including Egregor.

curator_note: Modeled from the ransomware payload perspective: Egregor delivery is associated with QakBot/Qbot activity, not ancestry.
confidence_reason: NHS and MITRE provide direct delivery claims, and Sophos provides supporting campaign context.
